product_metadata.title: Bubba Brands Trailblazer Water Bottle, 40oz, Very Berry Blue
features: Vacuum-insulated, double-wall stainless steel water bottle keeps drinks cold up to 24 hours without sweating
Easy-to-use straw spout snaps closed for leak-proof convenience on the go
Protective mouthpiece cover keeps out dirt and germs
Hefty 3-finger handle lets you carry fully loaded large-capacity bottle anywhere with ease
Lid can be unscrewed to add ice cubes and clean thoroughly
description: Heading to a concert with friends or finally taking that beach trip you keep talking about? Be sure to bring along the bubba trailblazer insulated stainless steel water bottle with straw, 40 oz. It will keep your favorite drink cold up to 24 hours with no sweating. Its leak-proof lid, easy-to-use straw spout and spout cover securely close, making this bottle The perfect mess-free travel companion. A durable 3-finger handle integrated in the lid gives you the confidence to carry this large-capacity bottle with you anywhere a stroll on the beach to a walk through Festival grounds—even when fully loaded. Unscrew the leak-proof lid to add ice cubes and clean thoroughly. For added convenience, you can throw the BPA-free plastic lid onto the top rack of your dishwasher; just remember to hand-wash the stainless steel body and keep it out of the microwave. Rest assured, your bubba is for life. Here’s to the moment!
